thread:
Maria: Quick audit — need to prune and sharpen the competitor claim set for the webinar landing + battlecard. Short list attached.
Sam: SGTM. Do we have a primary nose-to-nose target? cloud infra or LLM APIs?
Maria: Focus: 1) Cloud AI platforms (latency/cost deflections) 2) LLM APIs (simplicity vs control) 3) Inference infra vendors (ops burden). Keep rebuts narrow.
Kevin: Can we make a micro-rebut for each? one-liner + data point.
Ana: I'll own webinar headline tests. Suggested A/B: "Predictable inference economics" vs "Lowest latency at scale".
Ben: Sales wants objection handles for procurement (TCO, compliance). Need quick bullets.
Maria: Draft rebut bullets:
- Cloud AI: "Managed but opaque pricing" -> our: "per-token economics with batching+KV cache savings; transparent token breakdown"
- LLM APIs: "ease of use" -> our: "same API across hosted/dedicated/private + SLA/backoff policies"
- Infra vendors: "you run it" -> our: "turnkey Dedicated + Private options; rollout & canary controls"
Kevin: Nice. Can we add a data point? e.g., `~2.5x lower per-token cost on batch-friendly chat workloads`
Sam: We have benchmark 2025-02: batch-friendly chat workload: Redwood median cost 0.35 vs managed endpoint 0.9 per 1k tokens. Use careful phrasing.
Maria: Phrase as: "Internal benchmark on a standard chat workload showed ~2.5x cost reduction vs a selected managed endpoint (median)." Legal okay?
Ana: Legal asked to avoid absolute claims. Add qualifiers: "typical", "internal benchmark", and link to the full methodology.
Ben: Sales asks for 2 quick soundbites for SDRs:
- "Ship fast with our hosted API, then scale to Dedicated for predictable unit economics."
- "Keep security and compliance with Private deployments and KMS integration."
Maria: Add quick code snippet for the landing page to show unified API:
```
// one-line SDK example
const r = await redwood.chat.create({ model: 'rwd-1', messages })
```
Sam: UX: can we run a 3-hour messaging lab tomorrow? quick votes on the 4 claim variants.
Ben: I can mobilize 3 AEs for field feedback.
deploy-bot: Reminder: webinar page push scheduled at 1755024000; if copy changes must be in PR by EOD today :bell: 
Maria: Ok owners: Ana (landing A/B), Kevin (bench phrasing), Sam (ops/infra lines), Ben (SDR soundbites). Quick turn — comments inline by 4pm.
Kevin: I'll draft the one-pager and post in #marketing-assets.
Ana: I'll set up A/B in LaunchDarkly and share link.
Sam: Will add ops diagram (routing + fallback policy).
Ben: I'll compile 3 procurement bullets + pricing script.
Maria: Thanks all — small, sharp edits. :rocket:
